findings.claim: The commit says it only removes branch naming from the landing rule, but it also changes the non-terminal instruction from "means it still runs: wait" to "means it runs: do not fire". "do not fire" has no object anywhere in the skill. The only other use of "fire" in this skill tree that is about closure is reference line 85 ("fire the archive-time sync trigger"), so a host can read the new text as "skip the sync trigger" or "abandon closure" instead of "wait and re-check later". The explicit wait instruction is gone, so a closure run that finds a still-running chain is no longer told to come back. The new pin in engine/skills/inception_family_artifact_test.go:114 requires this exact ambiguous wording, so a clarifying edit would now fail the test. The change also does nothing toward the stated purpose (no branch named), so its reason is not recorded.
